purpose: Machine-readable audit contract for identifying shallow Atlas records and preventing snippet inflation.
interpretation: Counts in this file are audit targets/categories, not claims that every existing record has already been manually reviewed.

categories.label: name and short description only
categories.metadata: structured fields without enough explanatory substance
categories.substantive: coherent explanation with meaningful structure and evidence
categories.deep: substantive plus dense relationships and source architecture
categories.corpus: deep source record backed by actual reusable primary text and stable passage structure

automatic_checks: all relationship endpoints resolve or are explicitly unresolved research endpoints
all registered local source paths exist
no imported-and-verified text points only to an external URL
all major index entries expose useful local content and source trails
placeholder language is flagged rather than treated as substance
the unified index is the only required public reader
upgrade_rule: Upgrade the highest-connectivity shallow records first. Do not create hundreds of additional shallow records while high-value existing records remain thin.
routing_rule: A deep record is useful only when the reader can reach it from index.html and then follow its source, relationship and research trails without entering a parallel application.
